preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMarketingWallet() and setInvestingWallet() to redirect fund recipients to attacker-controlled addresses. Then trigger swapAndLiquify() by making a transfer that accumulates enough tokens in the contract (exceeding _minTokenBalance). The swapAndLiquify function will swap tokens for BNB and transfer the marketing fees to the attacker-controlled wallets, draining accumulated BNB from the contract.
